description: This file provides utility functions for acquiring and releasing threading and file locks with support for timeouts, including context managers for safe lock handling and unsafe manual control methods. It is part of a locking utility module within a larger project, specifically related to cache management and concurrency control.

classes.name: _LockProtocol
classes.description: Protocol defining a callable that acquires a lock with an optional timeout, returning a context manager.

methods.name: _acquire_lock_with_timeout
methods.description: Context manager that safely acquires a threading.Lock with timeout support, automatically releasing it.

methods.name: _unsafe_acquire_lock_with_timeout
methods.description: Function to acquire a threading.Lock with timeout support without automatic release; caller must release explicitly.

methods.name: _acquire_flock_with_timeout
methods.description: Context manager that safely acquires a FileLock with timeout support, automatically releasing it.

methods.name: _unsafe_acquire_flock_with_timeout
methods.description: Function to acquire a FileLock with timeout support without automatic release; caller must release explicitly.

methods.name: _acquire_many_impl_locks_with_timeout
methods.description: Context manager that acquires multiple cache implementation locks with timeout support, ensuring all are acquired before proceeding.
